title: Draft: Qt: Wider scrollbar pref
description:
This preference allows the scrollbar extent (width for vertical,
height for horizontal) to be increased.

While it is possible to use the proxy theme to turn off the
"completely disappearing scrollbar" that macOS does
(that's SH_ScrollBar_Transient), that does not control Windows 11
and the animated scrollbar that is narrowing until the area is moused
over.

However this change does provide a wider area to mouse over.

Fix #21512
